demos.name: NpmSparkLine
demos.description: The demo below shows how npm displays a package's weekly download trend in a sparkline.

demos.name: BasicSparkLine
demos.description: SparkLineChart only needs the data prop, which is an array of numbers.

demos.name: AreaSparkLine
demos.description: Set the area prop to fill the area under the curve.

demos.name: BasicSparkLineCustomization
demos.description: For more control, pass custom props to the tooltip and highlight slots.

demos.name: CustomAxis
demos.description: The sparkline has a single axis, so xAxis takes one axis configuration object, not an array.

demos.name: CustomYAxis
demos.description: The demo below shows two sparklines with different value scales: the first row uses the default y-axis, and the second row uses a fixed range from 0 to 100.

demos.name: CustomDomainYAxis
demos.description: The demo below uses the same data (values from -15 to 92) with different domainLimit settings.

demos.name: ColorCustomization
demos.description: Pass a color to the color prop to set the sparkline color.

demos.name: ColorCustomizationMode
demos.description: The demo below uses a white line in dark mode and a black line in light mode.

demos.name: SparklineLineWidth
demos.description: The demo below shows how stroke width, disableClipping, and clipAreaOffset affect the result.
